package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonrevision"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

// LessonHandler owns the private lesson-read endpoint.
type LessonHandler struct {
	RevisionsUC      lessonrevision.Definitions
	GetUC            lesson.GetLesson
	TeacherContextUC lesson.GetTeacherContext
}

type internalLessonResponse struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	CourseID    string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	SectionID   string `json:"section_id"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	Order       int    `json:"order"`
	Status      int    `json:"status"`
}

type teacherLessonContextResponse struct {
	LessonID        string `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID        string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	SectionID       string `json:"section_id,omitempty"`
	Language        string `json:"language"`
	Title           string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt         string `json:"excerpt"`
	Description     string `json:"description"`
	ContentRevision string `json:"content_revision"`
}

// GetInternalLesson returns lesson metadata for internal consumers.
func (h LessonHandler) GetInternalLesson(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID")
	item, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(internalLessonResponse{
		ID: item.ID, CourseID: item.CourseID, SectionID: item.SectionID,
		Title: item.Title, Excerpt: item.Excerpt, Description: item.Description,
		Order: item.Order, Status: item.Status,
	})
}

// GetTeacherContext returns a bounded canonical snapshot for teacher-agent.
func (h LessonHandler) GetTeacherContext(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	item, err := h.TeacherContextUC.Handle(
		r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID"), r.URL.Query().Get("language"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, "invalid lesson teacher context", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		default:
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(teacherLessonContextResponse{
		LessonID: item.LessonID, CourseID: item.CourseID, SectionID: item.SectionID,
		Language: item.Language, Title: item.Title, Excerpt: item.Excerpt,
		Description: item.Description, ContentRevision: item.Revision.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
	})
}
